answer.what_it_does: Agentforce is Salesforce’s AI agent platform for deploying autonomous agents that work across Salesforce workflows to answer questions, resolve cases, and take actions for customers and employees.[6][13] It is designed to connect with Salesforce data and business systems so agents can automate routine tasks, provide guidance, and support 24/7 operations.[7][13]

ai_agents.name: Service Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Handles customer support interactions, resolves cases, and helps troubleshoot issues using customer history and company knowledge.[6][14]

ai_agents.name: Sales Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Supports sales workflows by qualifying leads, sending outreach, and helping schedule follow-up actions.[6][12][14]
actions: Access calendar to schedule follow-up call
Search and pull in leads from an external system

ai_agents.name: Marketing Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Creates campaigns, content, and outreach messaging to support marketing execution.[2][6][12][14]

ai_agents.name: Commerce Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Helps manage commerce and ecommerce workflows such as promotions and order-related tasks.[2][6][12]

ai_agents.name: HR Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Assists with employee-facing HR tasks such as policy questions and onboarding.[6]

ai_agents.name: IT Help Desk Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Supports IT service workflows by helping resolve tickets and access issues.[6]

ai_agents.name: Financial Services Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Supports financial services workflows including risk assessment and investment planning.[2]

ai_agents.name: Healthcare Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Assists with patient-related analysis and compliance-oriented workflows.[2]

incidents_or_risks.what: Salesforce says Agentforce should generate test cases, inspect potential responses, and apply guardrails before production deployment, indicating risks around incorrect or unsafe agent output if controls are weak.

Salesforce documentation for example agents notes safeguards against dropped values, duplicate records, and false confirmations when creating records, showing the operational risk of data errors in agent-driven workflows.
Salesforce describes compliance features in industry use cases as part of the Trust Layer, implying privacy and regulatory risk considerations for sensitive workflows.

facts.claim: Agentforce is the agent-driven layer of the Salesforce Platform.
Agentforce is intended to deploy AI agents that work side-by-side with employees and serve customers 24/7.
Agentforce integrates with Customer 360 across Sales, Service, Marketing, and Commerce.
Salesforce markets Agentforce as enabling trusted autonomous AI agents to scale a workforce.
Agentforce can be used to automate tasks, gain insights, scale operations, and boost productivity.
Salesforce lists pre-built use cases including deflecting routine inquiries and reducing support costs without adding headcount.
Agentforce developer guidance includes custom actions, flows, prompt templates, and integrations with external systems.
Salesforce’s developer center for Agentforce references connecting language models to Salesforce and creating prompt templates for support-case summarization.

answer.what_it_does: Salesforce Agentforce is Salesforce’s platform for building and deploying AI agents that can use company data and take actions within Salesforce and connected systems. Agents use Salesforce “data, reasoning, and actions” to plan work and execute tasks with controls such as guardrails and auditing.

ai_agents.name: Agentforce (platform for building custom agents)
ai_agents.what_it_does: Provides an AI agent framework to create and customize agents that can be grounded in Salesforce and external data, then execute permitted actions in defined channels.
actions: Use “actions” to retrieve information or perform tasks in Salesforce (including standard and custom actions).
Execute custom actions created from Salesforce capabilities (e.g., Apex REST actions, Apex controller methods, named queries/SOQL, invocable Apex methods).
Ground agent responses in Salesforce CRM data and optionally other sources (e.g., knowledge articles, uploaded files, or web sources via search/web tools; plus RAG via Agentforce tooling).
Deploy agents to channels (messaging platforms/apps/interfaces) and manage connections/escalation routing for customer/employee interactions.

ai_agents.name: Agentforce Sales (out-of-the-box sales agents)
ai_agents.what_it_does: Delivers AI agents for sales workflows to handle high-volume sales “grind” activities so sellers can focus on relationship building and closing deals.
actions: Meeting-related operational support such as scheduling (described for sales development use cases).

ai_agents.name: Agentforce for Sales Development Representative (SDR) (out-of-the-box agent)
ai_agents.what_it_does: Supports sales teams with lead engagement and operational automation such as meeting scheduling.

use_cases.name: Sales development and lead engagement automation
what_the_agent_can_reach: Salesforce CRM data (Salesforce platform data that agents are grounded in).
Operational sales workflow tasks such as lead engagement and meeting scheduling (i.e., tasks executed via defined Salesforce actions).

use_cases.name: Service customer support and answer generation with grounding and escalation
use_cases.who_uses_it: Customer-facing service teams deploying Agentforce Service Agents
what_the_agent_can_reach: Customer and company data available in Salesforce (agent grounded in controlled Salesforce CRM data).
Knowledge articles and other unstructured sources made available to the agent via Agentforce data grounding tools.
Customer-facing channels with escalation paths for complex/sensitive conversations.

use_cases.name: Custom enterprise agent actions across Salesforce and connected systems (via custom actions)
use_cases.who_uses_it: Developers and Salesforce admins building custom Agentforce agents
what_the_agent_can_reach: Salesforce org capabilities exposed through actions (Apex REST, Apex controller methods, named queries/SOQL, invocable Apex).
Data accessible to grounded sources (CRM data plus knowledge/file/web sources depending on configured tools).

incidents_or_risks.what: Risk of storing Customer Data in Agentforce (privacy/data retention considerations) and uncertainty around data handling
Agent reliability and governance risk (actions and outputs require auditing/controls to ensure compliance and traceability of AI agent actions)

facts.claim: In Agentforce, “actions” are how an agent gets information or performs tasks, and agents can execute both standard actions and custom actions.
Agentforce agents are grounded in data; Salesforce states customers control what data agents can access, including integration with Salesforce CRM data.

Agentforce supports additional data sources including knowledge articles and fields, file uploads, and web sources via tools such as Agentforce Data Libraries and Search the Web; for unstructured sources, RAG can be used.
Salesforce describes Agentforce as built on the Salesforce Platform and organized around data, reasoning, and actions.

Salesforce provides a set of developer-recognized Agentforce action types, including Apex REST Actions, AuraEnabled Actions (Apex controller methods), Named Query Actions (SOQL), and Apex Invocable Method Actions.

Salesforce states Einstein Trust Layer includes guardrails such as “zero data retention,” toxicity detection, secure data retrieval, and dynamic grounding, and includes an Audit Trail feature to track AI agent actions/outputs.

Salesforce states Agentforce is the agentic layer of the unified Salesforce platform and is designed to integrate with Data Cloud for RAG/grounding in relevant structured and unstructured data uploaded to Data Cloud.

answer.what_it_does: Salesforce Agentforce is a platform that allows organizations to build and deploy autonomous AI agents capable of interacting with customer data and business systems to perform tasks. These agents work alongside human employees to automate complex workflows across service, sales, marketing, and commerce departments.

ai_agents.name: Service Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: An autonomous agent designed to handle customer service inquiries and resolve issues without human intervention.
actions: Executes resolutions via integrated third-party systems
Uses Large Language Models for natural language processing

ai_agents.name: Sales Development Representative (SDR) Agent
ai_agents.what_it_does: Automates the process of engaging with leads, answering questions, and scheduling meetings.

facts.claim: Agentforce agents are built on the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which allows them to plan, reason, and take action autonomously.
Agentforce integrates directly with Salesforce Data Cloud to ground AI responses in real-time, trusted company data.

answer.what_it_does: Agentforce is Salesforce's platform for building and deploying AI agents that can understand requests, make decisions, and take actions inside a Salesforce environment. It runs on the Salesforce Platform and uses Salesforce data, including Data 360, along with governance and guardrails to limit what agents can do.

ai_agents.name: Service Agent

Reads CRM and external data about prospects

incidents_or_risks.what: ForcedLeak: a critical vulnerability chain (CVSS 9.4) reported by Noma Labs in which a malicious Web-to-Lead submission used indirect prompt injection to make Agentforce expose CRM data through an expired, still-trusted domain. Salesforce patched it by enforcing Trusted URLs for Agentforce and Einstein AI.
incidents_or_risks.when: Reported to Salesforce July 28, 2025; public disclosure September 25, 2025

incidents_or_risks.what: ForcedLeak timeline and remediation details, including Salesforce implementing Trusted URLs enforcement on September 8, 2025.

SalesBleed: three vulnerabilities disclosed by Zenity Labs that could let an attacker submit a poisoned lead through a public Web-to-Lead form, later hijacking an Agentforce agent to leak CRM data or send phishing messages through its Slack integration. Zenity says the attack chains no longer work after fixes.
incidents_or_risks.when: Reported to Salesforce June 1, 2026; fixes confirmed by August 19, 2026; disclosed September 24, 2026

incidents_or_risks.what: The SalesBleed Slack-related flaw: the Reply to a Slack Thread action did not require user confirmation before sending and lacked visible attribution to the invoking user, so agent-sent messages could appear without approval.

facts.claim: Agentforce is built natively on the Salesforce Platform and connects to business data and metadata; Salesforce describes built-in encryption, policy enforcement, and access controls.
Agentforce agents can use structured and unstructured data, such as knowledge articles, CRM data, and data connected from external sources.
Agentforce Data Library and the Einstein Trust Layer require Data 360 to be provisioned and enabled.
Data Cloud was rebranded to Data 360 on October 14, 2025, with functionality unchanged.
Agent actions can be built from existing Flows, Apex, prompt templates, and APIs, and integrate with native tools such as Data 360, Slack, and MuleSoft.
Agentforce supports MCP and A2A open protocols for connecting agents to apps, APIs, and other agents, via MuleSoft Agent Fabric and Flow.
Agentforce Analytics is enabled by default when Agentforce is turned on and collects agent usage, user inputs, and engagement data; administrators can disable collection in Setup.

Agentforce Sales (formerly Sales Cloud) and Service Cloud have been rebuilt around Agentforce, and a third-party guide reports Salesforce cited 29,000 deals closed and $800 million in annual recurring revenue by early 2026 in its Q4 FY2026 earnings report.
Pricing for Agentforce was reported to start at $2 per conversation, with volume discounts, in a 2025 guide; current pricing may differ.
